headline: 英暖氣油漲價用戶获賠
context: 英國競爭與市場管理局（CMA）調查發現，中東情勢引發原油價格飆升期間，暖氣油業者片面取消訂單、改用更高價格重新收費，影響約1700名用戶。這些用戶現在最高可获得350英鎊的賠償。

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: The cost of heating oil spiked following the US-Israel war with Iran which forced up crude prices.
sources.title: Heating oil customers to get compensation after price hikes

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Watchdog says about 1,700 people were affected during a price surge triggered by the Middle East crisis Heating oil customers whose deliveries were cancelled when the war in the Middle East caused a price surge are to receive compensation of up to £350 each following an investigation by the UK competition watchdog. As the crisis unfolded, the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) said it was investigating heating oil suppliers after complaints that existing orders were being scrapped, with customers offered new deliveries at a significantly higher price. voice_text: 英國一批暖氣油用戶，這次能拿到賠償了。中東情勢讓原油價格飆升那段期間，有業者片面取消原本的訂單，換成更高價格重新收費，影響大約1700人。監管機關調查後決定，這些用戶最高可以拿到350英鎊賠償。
